outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs quantifying HMGB1 band intensity (mean ± SD, N=4) for nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions. These are bar charts of averaged data but do not show the individual data points (e.g., dots for each of the 4 replicates) overlaid on the bars.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
